column1: TABLE 1. Area Measurements (in mm²) and Percentages of Body Part Representations Within Somatosensory Cortex^1

^1The three cases shown had the highest resolution, the most definable boundaries and were considered fairly complete. Percentages of S1 and S2 areas are relative to Tot. SS. Area measurements of the digits, vibrissae, rostrum, and hindlimb/trunk are taken from the S1 area only and percentages reflect the proportion of that representation within S1. For abbreviations, see list. Table was produced by using Canvas 3.5.5.
